faq.question: Is hot sauce allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Hot Sauce is restricted in carry-on luggage. Hot sauce is a liquid and is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Carry-on bottles must be 3.4 oz (100 ml) or less.

faq.question: Can you pack hot sauce in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Hot Sauce is allowed in checked bags. Hot sauce is allowed in checked baggage in any size.
